did: Built the first half of the Rust Rounds work tracker on the phone. You start it on a ticket, it stops itself after two hours, and when you come back it asks whether you were working the whole time: all of it, part in fifteen-minute steps, or none. Each start and answer is kept on the phone first and sent home as kept, so a span started offline is never lost; a start home refuses because it overlaps another span stays on the phone and out of the total. The week's brief now shows your desk time as a bar per ticket, with a table view. Three independent reviews and Codex found three real bugs before merge, all fixed: an answered span coming back, a close stamped before its start blocking the queue, and a span started offline being reset by a second screen.

calls.title: A span starts offline and is kept on the phone first
options: keep on the phone first, send from the lane
calls.why: The tracker is for work away from the phone, often with no home in reach; never losing the record outweighs knowing at once about a span on another device.
calls.undo: Make start wait for home's answer (C720).

calls.title: A start home refuses for good stays on the phone and out of the total
options: keep it, out of the total
calls.why: Counting overlapping time twice would misstate the week, and the record is append-only.
calls.undo: Count refused spans in the week's time (C721).

calls.title: Spans go home only once home serves this build
options: wait for home to serve this build
calls.why: It is how a week sent by points already waits, so there is one rule for what a newer build sends.
calls.undo: Gate spans on home's epoch 21 alone (C722).

calls.title: Where the tracker sits until the step screens land
options: Read view, and the brief while running or asking
calls.why: The step screens were another session's work; this put the tracker in reach now and leaves one line for that session to move.
calls.undo: Move the control onto the step screens (C724).

left: Visits in ENGAGE's words, visits by day and time on the phone (RR26 E2): they hang on RR25 D2's step screens, #3274, not yet merged.
The control still sits on the Read view; once #3274 lands it moves onto each step screen, with an exercise's own points.
The Pages viewer has no tracker yet; it was to keep time in memory only (C678).
A start home refuses for good drops to idle with no word on screen; a Notice belongs with the second-device work, as there is one phone today.
In the default light and dark themes the week's three step colours are shades of one blue; the legend, labels and table carry the step there.
